meta.name: Lapetco OXY 2 JV
meta.vehicle: Direct: each investor is a general partner (venturer) in a Texas joint venture
meta.summary: Units in a Texas general-partnership JV buying 7.98% WI / 5.99% NRI in five Oxy-operated 2-mile horizontals in Converse County, WY, for a fixed $4.5M turnkey price. Offered to existing investors at $250k; sponsor pitches 600 BOE/d per well, ~$60k back production per $250k by Dec 20 and an 85% write-off in 2026. Cutoff Nov 25, 2026.

documents.title: Lapetco email to Levi, Nov 2026: $250k offer, 600 BOE/d, back production, 85% write-off
Operating Agreement (Oxy), Turnkey Contract: NOT RECEIVED (CIM: available on request)
CIM Exhibit E 'Investment Return Illustrations and Assumptions': blank in the CIM received

diligence: 27% load: of the $4.5M turnkey, $3.28M is wells and acquisition; $776k management fee, $360k commissions, $87k overhead (CIM p.19). At Oxy's AFEs the venture's WI costs $3.18M, so investors pay 1.41x cost.
Tax: the CIM (p.40, capitals) warns investors after drilling may not get IDC; per the email the wells have produced since August. No tax opinion or ruling. Get a CPA opinion on the 85%.
Production: verify 600 BOE/d per well with WOGCC monthly volumes by API and Oxy revenue statements; the sponsor's numbers are gross revenue (no production taxes, LOE, gathering; gas priced as oil).

Liability: general partners, unlimited joint and several liability; special assessments with a 500% non-payment penalty; Lapetco's overrun cover capped at $250k and it has 'minimal capital' (CIM p.1-5).

Documents: CIM (Oct 8) says drilled but uncompleted; email says online since August. 'Near Keenesburg' is a Colorado town. Exhibit E blank. Prior-activity record lists gross well BOE, not investor distributions; 474,114 BOE appears under three ventures.
Track record: ask for distributions per unit from prior Converse County ventures (Nettie Bracken 12, Nitro Fed, Lake Solitude).
Regulatory history (CIM p.53): Virginia 1989 order, Illinois 2009 cease and desist, Colorado securities case (dismissed 2025).
Minimum: CIM minimum is 1/2 unit ($500k); the $250k ticket relies on the sponsor's discretion (CIM p.1).

sources.cases.base: LTEC assumptions, Nov 19 2026. WTI: Aug-Nov 2026 approx. actuals (Oct ~$104, Nov 11 $89.62, FRED via MarketXLS); EIA Nov STEO sees Brent ~$100 to year-end falling to ~$77 by Q4 2027. 80% oil (nearby Oxy Powell 3670-4-T2XH: 291k bbl / 257 MMcf). WY severance ~6% + ad valorem ~6%. Year-1 deduction 50% (post-completion entry; see diligence).
sources.cases.downside: LTEC: current rate 500 BOE/d (600+ may be flush or the best wells), steeper decline, $65 long-term WTI, 35% year-1 deduction
sources.cases.stress: LTEC: 450 BOE/d, steep decline, $55 WTI, a $100k-per-unit special assessment in mid-2027 (CIM p.2: assessments possible), 30% year-1 deduction

base.label: Our Base
